mapper.select: SELECT a.id AS "id", a.toll_number AS "tollNumber", IFNULL(patient.name, '') AS "patientName", a.payment_type AS "paymentType", IFNULL(paymentType.name, '') AS "paymentTypeName", a.toll_type AS "tollType", IFNULL(tollType.name, '') AS "tollTypeName", a.amount_receivable AS "amountReceivable", a.amount_received AS "amountReceived", a.amount_discounted AS "amountDiscounted", a.return_type AS "returnType", DATE_FORMAT(a.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "createDate" FROM toll_info a LEFT JOIN patient patient ON patient.id = a.patient_id LEFT JOIN sys_dict_item paymentType ON paymentType.value = a.payment_type LEFT JOIN sys_dict_item tollType ON tollType.value = a.toll_type WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND a.create_date >= #{startDate} AND a.create_date < #{endDate} ORDER BY a.create_date ASC, a.toll_number ASC

SELECT a.id AS "id", a.toll_id AS "tollId", a.amount_receivable AS "amountReceivable", a.amount_received AS "amountReceived", a.payment_type AS "paymentType", a.create_by AS "createBy", DATE_FORMAT(a.create_date, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS "createDate" FROM toll_audit_log a WHERE a.company_id = #{companyId} AND a.del_flag = #{delFlag} AND a.action = 'REFUND' AND a.create_date >= #{startDate} AND a.create_date < #{endDate} ORDER BY a.create_date ASC
